<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<toast launch="http://127.0.0.1:63711/react/?session=ses_probe_click">
  <visual>
    <binding template="ToastGeneric">
      <text>Pan: E2E probe session completed</text>
      <text>NCTEST click the button; browser should open the loopback URL</text>
    </binding>
  </visual>
  <actions>
    <action activationType="protocol" arguments="http://127.0.0.1:63711/react/?session=ses_probe_click" content="Open session"/>
  </actions>
</toast>
